name: Nuooly
headline: A vetted community platform for independent professionals, built from discovery to support
overview: Nuooly is an exclusive community for independent professionals in fields such as legal, accounting, HR, finance and IT. Members get a trusted peer network, mastermind groups, business resources and concierge support. Techlio built the full product: member sign-up and vetting, profiles, community search, memberships and payments, messaging and the admin dashboards the Nuooly team runs the community from.

solutions.title: Member onboarding and vetting
solutions.text: Sign-up with social login, a multi-step professional profile and a review workflow that moves applicants through vetting.

solutions.title: Community search and messaging
solutions.text: Search across members by practice area and expertise, with direct messages, projects and alerts to keep collaboration and referrals moving.

solutions.title: Memberships and payments
solutions.text: Membership plans with online payment, renewals and receipts handled automatically.

solutions.title: Automation and admin dashboards
solutions.text: Automated notifications, reminders and onboarding steps, with dashboards that show applications, membership and activity to the Nuooly team.

solutions.title: Security built in
solutions.text: Techlio's security baseline applied from the first sprint: OWASP-based secure coding and review, role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege access to cloud resources and vulnerability scans before each release. For Nuooly that means restricted access to member and vetting data and payment details handled by the payment provider rather than stored in the app.
